note: Source validated against the official Kumon UK and Singapore curricula (2026). Maths: levels 7A to O plus the X specialty tracks (XV Vectors, XM Transformations, XP Permutations, XS Statistics). English: 18 main levels 7A to L, with sub levels AI/AII through GI/GII for levels A to G. H to L are single levels. The final English level is L.
warning: This roadmap is maintained by hand and can lag behind the real worksheet content. Check it against the current week before trusting it.
stateNote: A section is marked current when at least one of its sub-sections is. More than one section can be current at once: the weekly homework runs several slots in parallel, so multiplication and division can advance on different sheets. Every current sub-section names the homework slot and rung that evidences it, from data/curriculum/position.json on 2026-10-11.

sections.label: Levels 7A to B
sections.sub: Early numeracy to 3 digit addition and subtraction

items.name: 7A - 2A
items.detail: Early numeracy: counting, number recognition, writing 1-100, mental addition +1 to +10

items.name: Level A
items.detail: Addition (sum up to 28), subtraction from up to 20, 200 sheets, SCT 1-3 min

items.name: Level B
items.detail: 2 and 3-digit addition and subtraction with carrying and borrowing, first word problems, SCT 1-5 min

items.name: C1-4
items.detail: Multiplication tables x1-x3, x1-x5, x1-x7, x1-x9 (recall drills)

items.name: C5-10
items.detail: 2-digit x 1-digit (5 progressive sections), then 3 or 4-digit x 1-digit
items.why: Slot 2A keeps a third of the drill here while the 2-digit x 2-digit layout is taught

items.name: C11
items.detail: Introduction to division, short division with no remainder

items.name: C12-15
items.detail: Division with remainders (4 sections)
items.why: Slot 2B is at rung 2B.2, short division with remainders, with the check written back

items.name: C16-17
items.detail: Division: 2-digit divided by 1-digit (2 sections)

items.name: C18-20
items.detail: Division: 3-digit divided by 1-digit (2 sections), Level C complete

items.name: D1-4
items.detail: 2-digit x 2-digit (3 sections), 3-digit x 2-digit
items.why: Slot 2A is at rung 2A.5, 2-digit x 2-digit, so the drill is already working above the Level C sheets

items.name: D5-8
items.detail: Mixed add and subtract, multiplication and division, division by 2-digit numbers (5 sections)

items.name: D9-12
items.detail: Division with quotients of 2 or more digits, introduction to fractions, reduction (4 sections, GCF)

items.name: Levels E-F
items.detail: All fraction operations, fraction and decimal conversions, order of operations, word problems

items.name: Levels G-H
items.detail: Negative integers, linear equations, simultaneous equations, functions and graphs

items.name: Levels I-O
items.detail: Factorisation, quadratics, Pythagoras, trigonometry, calculus, SCT up to 30-60 min

items.name: X-Levels
items.detail: XV Vectors, XM Transformations, XP Permutations and Combinations, XS Statistics (advanced elective tracks)

tracks.note: Reading comprehension in slot 1A is at rung 1A.4, inference from an unseen passage, which is ahead of the Kumon sheet position below. The selective test drives that, not Kumon.

items.name: 7A - 3A
items.detail: Phonics, word recognition, sight words, short passages, basic comprehension

items.name: Level 2A
items.detail: Longer passages, sequencing, nouns, verbs and adjectives, 50-word passage fluency

items.name: AI
items.detail: Structure of simple sentences, subject and predicate, basic punctuation

items.name: AII
items.detail: Sentence structure, thought sequence, vocabulary building, comprehension questions

items.name: BI
items.detail: Subject and predicate deeper, past tense expressions, modifiers, 5W-1H questions
items.why: Slot 1B is at rung 1B.3, subject and predicate in compound sentences, and 1C is at 1C.4 word families

items.name: BII
items.detail: Comparing and contrasting, reading speed 85 wpm, figurative language mastery

items.name: CI
items.detail: Constructing sentences, correct word order

items.name: CII
items.detail: Organising information, tenses and voices

items.name: DI
items.detail: Combining sentences, relative clauses

items.name: DII
items.detail: Main idea, understanding paragraphs, reported speech

items.name: EI-EII
items.detail: Topic and main idea of paragraphs, scene transition, reason and result

items.name: FI-FII
items.detail: Links within sentences (referring words, restatement), diagramming paragraphs, interpreting text

items.name: GI-GII
items.detail: Paragraph elements, impressions, sentiment, single-paragraph summary

sections.label: Levels H to L
sections.sub: Summarisation then critique, L is the final level

items.name: H - I
items.detail: Extended summarisation, character sentiment, key word relationships, concise comprehension answers

items.name: J - L
items.detail: Critical reading: plot, atmosphere, irony, literary characters, figurative language analysis, objective commentary

items.name: 7A - 3A
items.detail: Counting, number recognition, pencil tracing, writing 1-50, sequences to 100, addition +1 to +3

items.name: Level 2A
items.detail: Mental addition +4 to +10, adding up to 10, SCT 1-2 min per sheet

items.name: A9-12
items.detail: Subtraction 1-4: subtracting 1, 2, 3, and up to 3, from numbers up to 10

items.name: A13-20
items.detail: Subtraction 5-12: from numbers up to 11 then up to 20, summary, Level A complete

items.name: B1-10
items.detail: Vertical 2 and 3-digit addition with carrying, and mental addition that bridges a ten
items.why: Slot 2A is at rung 2A.3, addition within 100 crossing a ten, and 2B is at 2B.2, vertical addition with carrying

items.name: B11-20
items.detail: Vertical 2 and 3-digit subtraction with borrowing, first word problems, Level B complete

items.name: Level C
items.detail: Times tables x1-x9, 2 to 4-digit x 1-digit, short division, SCT 2-5 min. School does not teach the 7, 8, 9, 11 or 12 tables yet, so homework stays off them

items.name: Level D+
items.detail: Long division, 2-digit multiplication, fractions, algebra and beyond
